headline: Pi Brings MCP Into the Core
lede: Pi reverses course on Model Context Protocol. The change adds deferred tool loading and a JavaScript Codemode sandbox, keeping composition inside a controlled harness rather than exposing an undifferentiated tool shelf.

headline: A New Sol Arrives in Seven Days
lede: GPT-6.1 Sol replaces its predecessor after a single week, approaching Astra-level performance at the Sol line’s lower price. It improves coding, terminal use, and agentic work while consuming more output tokens.

headline: Can a Benchmark Catch a Quiet Nerf?
lede: Livenerf turns user reports of model degradation into a preregistered measurement problem. Daily tests, pinned harnesses, launch baselines, raw logs, and a 30-day series provide a cautious framework for separating serving changes from shifting expectations.

headline: Factorio Quality, Solved With Matrices
lede: Probabilistic upgrades and recycling loops make Factorio’s quality system look unruly. Exact rational calculations reduce the factory to vector and matrix transformations, yielding a browser tool for sizing machines and comparing strategies.

headline: A Browser Opens the Mouth of the Tooth
lede: Dental Scope turns tooth anatomy into an interactive 3D workspace. Built with JavaScript and WebGL, the free explorer lets students rotate individual teeth and read their structures without paging through static diagrams.

headline: Efficiency Leaves the World With Fewer Buffers
lede: A Polish view of 2026 traces war, energy shocks, weak harvests, and financial pressure through the systems that connect distant crises to household costs. Its conclusion is reflective but practical: resilience requires redundancy, stockpiles, and institutions that can absorb surprise.

headline: OpenAI Puts Agents on Continuous Duty
lede: Dots gives GPT-6 Astra dedicated cloud computers, persistent memory, and access to work across connected services. The quiet technical question is not whether an agent can act, but how permissions, approvals, privacy, and oversight hold up while it remains online.

headline: Vermont Turns Home Batteries Into a Power Plant
lede: Green Mountain Power aggregates batteries in more than 5,500 homes into a virtual power plant. The network supplies capacity during demand peaks and outages while giving households backup power and a possible alternative to fossil-fuel peaker plants.

headline: Counterfeit Postage Scheme Meets Its Shutdown
lede: Postal inspectors seized LabelsBank.com after investigators linked it to more than 5.1 million allegedly counterfeit labels. The fixed-price operation may have cost USPS $126 million in legitimate postage; the charges remain allegations awaiting court.

headline: America.gov Tries to Make Government Legible
lede: A new federal portal uses AI to gather answers from roughly 29,000 government websites. Its promise is straightforward access to public services; its test will be whether source attribution, privacy, and accountability survive the convenience.
pullquote: Public-service AI is only as trustworthy as the institutions it makes easier to navigate.
